notes.title: Minor bugs and adjustments to the game
notes.content:
Hi there! Betetiro here. I want to thank everyone for the support I've received and for the valuable feedback on my game. There are still some unresolved issues that are taking more time to test and implement, so I'll be back with updates on those unresolved matters soon.

So, what are the changes?

- The secret ending has been removed, and the script has been slightly modified. I received a lot of feedback concerning the secret ending and the game in general. I realize that I've made mistakes. After speaking with individuals who have experienced the mental health issues discussed in the game, I've revised the script to be more sensitive and accurate. I apologize for the initial decision to include that content, and without your feedback, I wouldn't have realized the impact. I am grateful that you guided me to the right decision.

- Bugs in the Ukrainian version: there were issues with taking screenshots, and problems with the automatic self-voicing in the history section.

- Minor errors in both Ukrainian and English translations.

There's still a long road ahead, and I'm grateful for the feedback you've provided. The major issues I am now aware of include:

- Voicing problems (volume, line cut-offs)
- Typos that need correction to improve the text
- Issues with the music looping
- Lastly, I would like to implement some features suggested by the community. I hope to announce these soon.

Thank you again for your support, and I truly hope you have a wonderful day!

notes.title: Hazy Mind will be released on March 4!
notes.content:
Hi!! I am Betetiro, the creator of Hazy Mind, and I am thrilled to announce that Hazy Mind [i][b]will be released on March 4!![/b][/i]

It has definitely been a long road, with its own challenges, but I am very excited to release it soon. The original plan was to release it in February, however, we encountered some issues, and therefore the release date was slightly postponed.

[i]This was a unique experience and a great opportunity to meet all the wonderful people who supported me.[/i]

[h2]What are features of Hazy Mind?[/h2]
- [b]35k words, 7 endings[/b]
- [b]Secret ending with an explanation[/b]
- Amazing English and Ukrainian voiceovers with the help of [url=https://laurenkong.carrd.co/]Lauren Kong[/url], who voiced Morana in the English version, and [url=https://twitter.com/LeventeTarr]Levente Tarr[/url], who voiced the Demon in the English version. For the Ukrainian version: MeulinUwU voiced Morana, and Oleksandr Ometsinskyi (Omen_sky) voiced the Demon. These people are amazing, and I am forever grateful for their help. [b]Thank you.[/b]
- Japanese and Turkish translations are currently available, but I will add more languages with future patches. A big thank you to [url=https://nicolith.crd.co]nicolith[/url] for the Japanese translation, and to Arda Özükurt and Anıl Yılmaz for the Turkish translation. [b]Thank you.[/b]

As you may have noticed, since the first announcement, [i]I've added a bit more content[/i], which is why it took a little more time.

[i][b]So, we are waiting until March 4[/b][/i], and I wish you a great day. Thank you for supporting me all the way. It really matters. [i]Thanks.[/i]

I really hope you will like it. If you have any feedback or something important to share, you can also write to me at email: [b]betetirowork@gmail.com[/b].

Also, check out the works of the amazing artists and testers who created fan art for the game

notes.title: UPDATE on Release Date
notes.content:
[b]Hi there! Betetiro here.[/b]

[i]I've got some great news – we've completed the localizations for the[/i] [b]Turkish and Japanese[/b] [i]versions[/i]! It's really exciting because now people from all around the world can enjoy our game, thanks to our amazing volunteers!

[h4]I'm incredibly thankful for their help. The Turkish translation was done by Arda Özükurt and Anıl Yılmaz. The Japanese translation was done by [url=https://nicolith.crd.co]nicolith[/url].[/h4]

Currently, I'm integrating the Japanese translation into the game, while the Turkish and English versions are all set. [b]Sounds cool, doesn’t it? I thought so too.[/b]

Now, let's talk about what we've achieved and the challenges we've faced. Our testers discovered quite a few bugs during testing, both major issues and minor errors. It took a considerable amount of time to address and fix these, as I want to ensure you have a flawless gaming experience and am committed to not releasing the game before it’s ready. Initially, I was optimistic about a mid-January release, but as I sit here, I realize my caution about potential bugs and issues was warranted. [b]Therefore, the game is now set to be published in February. I hope this doesn't disappoint you; I'm doing my best to deliver the game as soon as possible![/b] [i]I can’t specify an exact release date right now, as I don't want to commit to a date and then potentially face delays due to unforeseen errors.[/i] [b]Rest assured, I will announce the date once the game is fully polished and ready with all the promised localizations.[/b]

I've also added some fun achievements and have already tested them!
And yeah, watch this
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43957091/83ab928196f7dad52aeecc74c39c939642d8335b.png[/img]

[h4]I really wish I could publish the game as soon as possible and see your feedback—I truly do![/h4]

Oh, and I almost forgot to mention that I've added new endings. [b]Now, there will be 7 endings in total, plus 1 secret ending (which you'll unlock after completing the 5 most crucial endings) that will explain the game and what I really wanted to share with you through this story.[/b] So, I guess this is goodbye for now, but I'll definitely be back next time with the release date. [i]Your support inspires me to keep going and not give up. I'm so grateful for everyone who's waiting for the game. I'm also looking forward to hearing your feedback.[/i]

[b]Hope to see you soon! Thank you, and have a great day. Take care, and I wish you all the best![/b]
